point_rule: One perk point per player level above 1 (points_total = player_level - 1). Purchased skills and their spent points live in the world save's progression state. Calling gates which Paths are purchasable; tier gates open by count of skills already purchased in that Path.

support_legend.live: Wired to an existing authoritative hook and changes gameplay now.
support_legend.deferred: Data-defined but gameplay-inert this pass. The `hook` field says which: 'HOOK EXISTS (wiring staged): …' means the authoritative hook is identified and only the wiring is deferred; 'MISSING: …' means it needs a new mechanism (handoff constraint 7).
support_legend.partial: Reserved: an aggregate with only some components wired.

perks.description: Permanently increases maximum health.

perks.hook: player.armor_total() scale
perks.description: Increases the protection supplied by equipped armor. Does not amplify weapons, tools, or unrelated effects.

perks.hook: MISSING: per-citizen damage-taken buff (subjects take no scaled combat damage hook)

perks.hook: MISSING: enemy 'currently attacking citizen/structure' target state

rule: A character's Calling gates which two Paths are purchasable; both of the Calling's Paths remain available. Tiers open by count of skills already purchased in that Path (II at 2, III at 6, capstone at 9 non-capstone). Calling, purchased skills, levels, and perk points are character-owned.
